targets.name: VDP_WriteThreeDigitValue
targets.continuation: falls through to VDP_WriteDecimalDigit for the final divisor

targets.name: VDP_WriteDecimalDigit
targets.input: value in D3 and divisor in D4

boundary_basis: The ASCII writer ends at its direct RTS at 0x001B045E-0x001B045F.
The three-digit wrapper contains two BSR calls and falls through to the third digit helper at 0x001B047A, so its non-overlapping owned prefix ends at 0x001B0479.
The decimal helper ends at its direct RTS at 0x001B048E-0x001B048F and is byte-for-byte equivalent in operation to SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit at 0x001B34B4.
